parts.zh: M: 你觉得新工作怎么样？
W: 到目前为止，一切都不错
M: 从你描述上一家公司的情况来看
M: 我们公司的经理往往比较体谅人
W: 这并不奇怪。我现在的公司似乎采用了一套兼顾同理心和直率的反馈政策
M: 但这应该建立在相互信任的氛围之上
W: 没错。没有信任的氛围
M: 是的。毕竟，建设性的反馈正是我们学习和成长的方式

items.stem: How does the woman describe her previous company's culture?

choices.text: Weird.
choices.zh: 古怪的。

choices.text: Efficient.
choices.zh: 高效的。

choices.text: Tolerant.
choices.zh: 宽容的。

choices.text: Toxic.
choices.zh: 有毒的。

items.stem: What does the man say about his company's managers?

choices.text: They are arrogant.
choices.zh: 他们傲慢自大。

choices.text: They are ignorant.
choices.zh: 他们无知。

choices.text: They are ambitious.
choices.zh: 他们雄心勃勃。

choices.text: They are accommodating.
choices.zh: 他们乐于助人。

items.stem: What does the woman say the employees in her new company can do?

choices.text: They can think big.
choices.zh: 他们能有远大理想。

choices.text: They can air their views.
choices.zh: 他们能表达自己的观点。

choices.text: They can break conventions.
choices.zh: 他们能打破常规。

choices.text: They can work flexible hours.
choices.zh: 他们能弹性工作。

items.stem: What does the man say about constructive feedback?

choices.text: It can alter people's mindsets.
choices.zh: 它能改变人们的思维方式。

choices.text: It can lead to new discoveries.
choices.zh: 它能带来新发现。

choices.text: It enables people to learn and grow.
choices.zh: 它使人们能够学习和成长。

choices.text: It is conducive to critical thinking.
choices.zh: 它有助于批判性思维。

items.stem: What does the man say about his holiday?

choices.text: He kept looking for the best place to stay.
choices.zh: 他一直在寻找最好的住处。

choices.text: He met many tourists from other countries.
choices.zh: 他遇到了许多来自其他国家的游客。

choices.text: He had a great time sightseeing and relaxing.
choices.zh: 他在观光和休闲方面度过了美好时光。

choices.text: He managed to visit a different city each day.
choices.zh: 他设法每天都游览一个不同的城市。

items.stem: What does the woman say people tend to do when making decisions?

choices.text: Prioritize what is essential to their best advantage.
choices.zh: 优先考虑对自己最有利的关键事项。

choices.text: Stretch out the process in search of the optimal.
choices.zh: 延长过程以寻求最优选择。

choices.text: Deliberate the consequences that may occur.
choices.zh: 考虑可能发生的后果。

choices.text: Take all relevant factors into consideration.
choices.zh: 将所有相关因素纳入考虑。

items.stem: What has made decision making increasingly difficult?

choices.text: Time pressure.
choices.zh: 时间压力。

choices.text: Tight budget.
choices.zh: 预算紧张。

choices.text: Modern technology.
choices.zh: 现代技术。

choices.text: Fierce competition.
choices.zh: 激烈竞争。

items.stem: According to the woman, what should people do when making important decisions?

choices.text: Research as many different options as possible.
choices.zh: 研究尽可能多的不同选项。

choices.text: Avoid going over the same options repeatedly.
choices.zh: 避免反复考虑相同的选项。

choices.text: Focus on what is practical.
choices.zh: 关注实际可行的方面。

choices.text: Trust their gut instinct.
choices.zh: 相信自己的直觉。

items.stem: What did the 2006 research find about homework?

choices.text: It is beneficial to poor as well as rich communities.
choices.zh: 它对贫困社区和富裕社区都有益。

choices.text: It is conducive to children's future development.
choices.zh: 它有助于儿童的未来发展。

choices.text: It is welcome to parents but not to children.
choices.zh: 家长欢迎它,但儿童不欢迎。

choices.text: It is not of much help to younger children.
choices.zh: 它对年龄较小的儿童帮助不大。

items.stem: What do experts think of homework requiring internet access?

choices.text: It may put some students in remote areas at a disadvantage.
choices.zh: 它可能使偏远地区的一些学生处于不利地位。

choices.text: It gives the majority of students ready access to their teachers.
choices.zh: 它使大多数学生能够随时联系到他们的老师。

choices.text: It effectively improves the learning quality of students in rural areas.
choices.zh: 它有效地提高了农村地区学生的学习质量。

choices.text: It can bridge the learning gap between kids of different backgrounds.
choices.zh: 它可以弥合不同背景孩子之间的学习差距。

items.stem: What conclusion could be drawn from the study in Germany?

choices.text: Diligent students tend to do their homework independently.
choices.zh: 勤奋的学生倾向于独立完成家庭作业。

choices.text: The focus of homework should always be on school subjects.
choices.zh: 家庭作业的重点应始终放在学校科目上。

choices.text: Doing homework exerts a positive effect on kids' personality development.
choices.zh: 做家庭作业对孩子的性格发展产生积极影响。

choices.text: The benefits of doing homework vary widely from individual to individual.
choices.zh: 做家庭作业的益处因人而异,差异很大。

items.stem: What do we learn about Goddard's idea of using rockets for space exploration?

choices.text: It was something he apologized for later.
choices.zh: 这是他后来道歉的事情。

choices.text: It was ridiculed by the New York Times.
choices.zh: 它遭到了《纽约时报》的嘲笑。

choices.text: It was a forty-nine-year plan.
choices.zh: 这是一个四十九年的计划。

choices.text: It was considered visionary.
choices.zh: 它被认为具有远见。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Goddard's first rocket voyage?

choices.text: It was of great significance to rocket science.
choices.zh: 它对火箭科学具有重大意义。

choices.text: It was completed in the state of New Mexico.
choices.zh: 它是在新墨西哥州完成的。

choices.text: It was somehow delayed about 12 minutes.
choices.zh: 它不知何故延迟了大约12分钟。

choices.text: It failed due to a sudden change of weather.
choices.zh: 它因天气突变而失败。

items.stem: Why did Goddard move to New Mexico?

choices.text: A laboratory and test range was already set up there.
choices.zh: 那里已经建立了一个实验室和测试场。

choices.text: Its climate was ideal for year-round rocket launching.
choices.zh: 那里的气候非常适合全年发射火箭。

choices.text: A weather expert invited him to go there for his mission.
choices.zh: 一位气象专家邀请他去那里执行任务。

choices.text: Its remote valleys were appealing to him and his family.
choices.zh: 那里偏远的山谷对他和他的家人很有吸引力。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Goddard's achievements?

choices.text: He won an award from the US government for his work.
choices.zh: 他因其工作获得了美国政府的奖项。

choices.text: He gained recognition from rocket scientists worldwide.
choices.zh: 他获得了全世界火箭科学家的认可。

choices.text: He was granted over 200 patents in rocket technology.
choices.zh: 他获得了200多项火箭技术专利。

choices.text: He boosted the military strength of the United States.
choices.zh: 他增强了美国的军事实力。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about working for a new venture?

choices.text: It requires entrepreneurial experience.
choices.zh: 这需要创业经验。

choices.text: It is usually financially rewarding.
choices.zh: 这通常在经济上是有回报的。

choices.text: It can be quite frustrating.
choices.zh: 这可能相当令人沮丧。

choices.text: It can be rather risky.
choices.zh: 这可能相当有风险。

items.stem: What has science demonstrated regarding the positive culture of a new venture?

choices.text: It contributes to rapid business expansion.
choices.zh: 它有助于快速的业务扩张。

choices.text: It inspires willingness to make sacrifices.
choices.zh: 它激发做出牺牲的意愿。

choices.text: It reduces conflict among team members.
choices.zh: 它减少团队成员之间的冲突。

choices.text: It encourages creation and innovation.
choices.zh: 它鼓励创造和创新。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about entrepreneurs at the initial stage of a new venture?

choices.text: They have unrealistic expectations.
choices.zh: 他们有不切实际的期望。

choices.text: They often work without any pay.
choices.zh: 他们常常无偿工作。

choices.text: Few can find willing investors.
choices.zh: 很少有人能找到愿意投资的人。

choices.text: Many are idealistic dreamers.
choices.zh: 许多人是理想主义的梦想家。

items.stem: What do we learn about the possible reason why women tend to live longer?

choices.text: They have better dietary habits.
choices.zh: 她们有更好的饮食习惯。

choices.text: They bear fewer social responsibilities.
choices.zh: 她们承担较少的社会责任。

choices.text: They are born with a stronger ability to socialize.
choices.zh: 她们天生具有更强的社交能力。

choices.text: They are better able to survive or handle disease.
choices.zh: 她们更能够存活下来或应对疾病。

items.stem: What is the recent discovery about human cells?

choices.text: They have a limited reproductive ability.
choices.zh: 它们的繁殖能力有限。

choices.text: They depend on adequate sleep to thrive.
choices.zh: 它们依赖充足的睡眠才能茁壮生长。

choices.text: They keep dividing throughout one's life.
choices.zh: 它们在人的一生中持续分裂。

choices.text: They strengthen with regular exercise.
choices.zh: 它们通过定期锻炼而增强。

items.stem: What do many public health policy makers believe?

choices.text: The process of ageing can ultimately be brought under control.
choices.zh: 衰老过程最终能够被控制。

choices.text: Improved health care for the elderly will contribute to longevity.
choices.zh: 改善老年人医疗保健将有助于延长寿命。

choices.text: Prevention of heart disease and stroke will increase life expectancy.
choices.zh: 预防心脏病和中风将提高预期寿命。

choices.text: The resolution of age-related diseases will solve the mystery of ageing.
choices.zh: 解决与年龄相关的疾病将解开衰老之谜。

items.stem: Why are managers often frustrated with their employees?

choices.text: They are reluctant to follow instructions.
choices.zh: 他们不愿意遵循指示。

choices.text: They fail to answer emails promptly.
choices.zh: 他们未能及时回复电子邮件。

choices.text: They cannot understand directives.
choices.zh: 他们无法理解指令。

choices.text: They do not show due respect.
choices.zh: 他们没有表现出应有的尊重。

items.stem: Why do employees sometimes disobey procedures intentionally?

choices.text: They have not been trained to follow the rules.
choices.zh: 他们没有接受过遵守规则的培训。

choices.text: They are not satisfied with the management.
choices.zh: 他们对管理层不满意。

choices.text: They want to avoid unnecessary losses.
choices.zh: 他们想要避免不必要的损失。

choices.text: They find their voice go unheeded.
choices.zh: 他们发现自己的声音无人理会。

items.stem: When are employees more likely to follow instructions, according to the researchers?

choices.text: When they are on good terms with their managers.
choices.zh: 当他们与管理者关系良好时。

choices.text: When they find their job goals easily attainable.
choices.zh: 当他们发现自己的工作目标容易实现时。

choices.text: When they find their supervisors helpful.
choices.zh: 当他们发现主管乐于助人时。

choices.text: When they are financially motivated.
choices.zh: 当他们受到经济激励时。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about emails?

choices.text: They are a useless tool for managers to change employee behavior.
choices.zh: 它们对于管理者改变员工行为来说是无用的工具。

choices.text: They prove to be a good means for managers to give instructions.
choices.zh: 事实证明它们是管理者发出指示的好方法。

choices.text: They should be reserved for urgent communication.
choices.zh: 它们应该留作紧急沟通使用。

choices.text: They are seldom used for sharing confidential data.
choices.zh: 它们很少用于共享机密数据。
